t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Most pointed hats score better than flat hats, pink yellow and purple were higher scorers however some scenarios showed 2 flat hats or 2 pointed hats and therefore this came down to a guess as to which would score better.

vb_textbox.text: Most pointed hats score better than flat hats (except for red flat hats which I think scored well). The brown and pink pointed hats scored well. I felt that i may have been penalised for missing the timer to press the space button so try to ensure you press that in time.
